fullText.simplified:
勇敢的女人

    雨已经停了。雨水很快被太阳晒干了。
    周明回到家里，还是有点迷糊，就像做梦一样。真奇怪，他只要一想到那个美丽的女子，就不能再想其他事了。
    到了晚上，周明让照顾他的下人们离开，只留自己一个人在家。不知道过了多久，那女子果然来了。
    周明给她开了门，女子微笑着对他说：“我的名字叫温姬，见到您真开心。”温姬歪了歪头，看着周明：“我很喜欢先生，您真是一个英俊又迷人的男人，所以我从那里偷偷跑来找您了。虽然我的身份不好，但我希望您知道我的心：我想一直和您在一起。”
    让一个女人说出喜欢你，是多么难的一件事啊！
    温姬的勇敢和直接都让周明想不到。真是奇怪，周明以前见过的女孩都是害羞的，温柔的。就像周明的姐姐和妹妹，她们只会乖乖地坐在家里学习怎么当一个好妻子、好母亲。如果有一个女孩说她喜欢哪个男人，那别人一定会说她“不知羞”。周明以前也觉得像母亲、姐妹那样的女人很好。但现在，他的想法忽然变了。
    “难道是因为温姬不懂这些吗？但是，谁又规定了女孩子都要是一样的脾气？乖乖的女孩很好，像温姬这样也很可爱，不是吗？”
    周明心里想着，呆呆地看着温姬，发现她的笑容里藏着害羞和调皮。周明知道，她为自己的主动而害羞，同时，她也对自己很有自信。她知道，面前的人是不会拒绝她，指责她的。
    周明也忍不住笑了，他的眼睛弯弯的，看着美丽的温姬，伸出手轻轻抱住她了。
    一阵夜风轻轻地吹进窗户，吹在两颗火热的心上。窗外的星星闪闪发亮，蝴蝶也落在树叶上睡了。在这个美丽的春夜，他遇到了美丽的温姬。
fullText.traditional:
勇敢的女人

    雨已經停了。雨水很快被太陽曬乾了。
    周明回到家裡，還是有點迷糊，就像做夢一樣。真奇怪，他只要一想到那個美麗的女子，就不能再想其他事了。
    到了晚上，周明讓照顧他的下人們離開，只留自己一個人在家。不知道過了多久，那女子果然來了。
    周明給她開了門，女子微笑著對他說：“我的名字叫溫姬，見到您真開心。”溫姬歪了歪頭，看著周明：“我很喜歡先生，您真是一個英俊又迷人的男人，所以我從那裡偷偷跑來找您了。雖然我的身份不好，但我希望您知道我的心：我想一直和您在一起。”
    讓一個女人說出喜歡你，是多麼難的一件事啊！
    溫姬的勇敢和直接都讓周明想不到。真是奇怪，周明以前見過的女孩都是害羞的，溫柔的。就像周明的姐姐和妹妹，她們只會乖乖地坐在家裡學習怎麼當一個好妻子、好母親。如果有一個女孩說她喜歡哪個男人，那別人一定會說她“不知羞”。周明以前也覺得像母親、姐妹那樣的女人很好。但現在，他的想法忽然變了。
    “難道是因為溫姬不懂這些嗎？但是，誰又規定了女孩子都要是一樣的脾氣？乖乖的女孩很好，像溫姬這樣也很可愛，不是嗎？”
    周明心裡想著，呆呆地看著溫姬，發現她的笑容裡藏著害羞和調皮。周明知道，她為自己的主動而害羞，同時，她也對自己很有自信。她知道，面前的人是不會拒絕她，指責她的。
    周明也忍不住笑了，他的眼睛彎彎的，看著美麗的溫姬，伸出手輕輕抱住她了。
    一陣夜風輕輕地吹進窗戶，吹在兩顆火熱的心上。窗外的星星閃閃發亮，蝴蝶也落在樹葉上睡了。在這個美麗的春夜，他遇到了美麗的溫姬。

sentences.english: Although my status is not good, I hope you know my heart: I want to be with you always.”

sentences.traditional: 讓一個女人說出喜歡你，是多麼難的一件事啊！

sentences.english: How difficult it is for a woman to say she likes you!

sentences.english: Wen Ji’s bravery and directness surprised Zhou Ming.

sentences.traditional: 真是奇怪，周明以前見過的女孩都是害羞的，溫柔的。

sentences.english: It was really strange. The girls that Zhou Ming had met before were all shy and gentle.

sentences.traditional: 就像周明的姐姐和妹妹，她們只會乖乖地坐在家裡學習怎麼當一個好妻子、好母親。
sentences.pinyin: jiù xiàng zhōu míng de jiě jie hé mèi mei tā men zhǐ huì guāi guāi de zuò zài jiā lǐ xué xí zěn me dāng yí ge hǎo qī zi hǎo mǔ qīn
sentences.english: Just like Zhou Ming’s sisters, they would just obediently sit at home and learn how to be good wives and good mothers.

sentences.traditional: 如果有一個女孩說她喜歡哪個男人，那別人一定會說她“不知羞”。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yǒu yí ge nǚ hái shuō tā xǐ huan nǎ ge nán rén nà bié ren yí dìng huì shuō tā bù zhī xiū
sentences.english: If there was a girl who said that she liked a man, then others would definitely say that she was “shameless”.

sentences.simplified: 周明以前也觉得像母亲、姐妹那样的女人很好。但现在，他的想法忽然变了。
sentences.traditional: 周明以前也覺得像母親、姐妹那樣的女人很好。但現在，他的想法忽然變了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng yǐ qián yě jué de xiàng mǔ qīn jiě mèi nà yàng de nǚ rén hěn hǎo dàn xiàn zài tā de xiǎng fǎ hū rán biàn le
sentences.english: Zhou Ming used to think that women like his mother and sisters were very good. But now, he suddenly changed his mind.

sentences.simplified: “难道是因为温姬不懂这些吗？但是，谁又规定了女孩子都要是一样的脾气？
sentences.traditional: “難道是因為溫姬不懂這些嗎？但是，誰又規定了女孩子都要是一樣的脾氣？
sentences.pinyin: nán dào shì yīn wèi wēn jī bù dǒng zhè xiē ma dàn shì shéi yòu guī dìng le nǚ hái zi dōu yào shi yí yàng de pí qi
sentences.english: “Is it because Wen Ji doesn’t understand this? But who has stipulated that all girls must have the same temper?

sentences.simplified: 乖乖的女孩很好，像温姬这样也很可爱，不是吗？”
sentences.traditional: 乖乖的女孩很好，像溫姬這樣也很可愛，不是嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: guāi guāi de nǚ hái hěn hǎo xiàng wēn jī zhè yàng yě hěn kě ài bú shì ma
sentences.english: Good girls are very good, but Wen Ji is also very cute like this, isn’t she?”

sentences.simplified: 周明心里想着，呆呆地看着温姬，发现她的笑容里藏着害羞和调皮。
sentences.traditional: 周明心裡想著，呆呆地看著溫姬，發現她的笑容裡藏著害羞和調皮。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng xīn li xiǎng zhe dāi dāi de kàn zhe wēn jī fā xiàn tā de xiào róng lǐ cáng zhe hài xiū hé tiáo pí
sentences.english: Zhou Ming thought to himself, staring at Wen Ji blankly, and found that her smile was shy and mischievous.

sentences.simplified: 周明知道，她为自己的主动而害羞，同时，她也对自己很有自信。
sentences.traditional: 周明知道，她為自己的主動而害羞，同時，她也對自己很有自信。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng zhī dào tā wèi zì jǐ de zhǔ dòng ér hài xiū tóng shí tā yě duì zì jǐ hěn yǒu zì xìn
sentences.english: Zhou Ming knew that she was shy of her own initiative, and at the same time, she was also very confident in herself.

sentences.simplified: 她知道，面前的人是不会拒绝她，指责她的。
sentences.traditional: 她知道，面前的人是不會拒絕她，指責她的。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào miàn qián de rén shì bú huì jù jué tā zhǐ zé tā de
sentences.english: She knew that the person in front of her would not reject her or criticize her.

sentences.simplified: 周明也忍不住笑了，
sentences.traditional: 周明也忍不住笑了，
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng yě rěn bú zhù xiào le
sentences.english: Zhou Ming couldn’t help but smile.

sentences.simplified: 他的眼睛弯弯的，看着美丽的温姬，伸出手轻轻抱住她了。
sentences.traditional: 他的眼睛彎彎的，看著美麗的溫姬，伸出手輕輕抱住她了。

sentences.english: His eyes were curved as he looked at the beautiful Wen Ji, and he reached out and hugged her gently.

sentences.simplified: 一阵夜风轻轻地吹进窗户，吹在两颗火热的心上。
sentences.traditional: 一陣夜風輕輕地吹進窗戶，吹在兩顆火熱的心上。
sentences.pinyin: yí zhèn yè fēng qīng qīng de chuī jìn chuāng hu chuī zài liǎng kē huǒ rè de xīn shang
sentences.english: A night breeze gently blew in through the window, blowing on two fiery hearts.

sentences.simplified: 窗外的星星闪闪发亮，蝴蝶也落在树叶上睡了。
sentences.traditional: 窗外的星星閃閃發亮，蝴蝶也落在樹葉上睡了。
sentences.pinyin: chuāng wài de xīng xing shǎn shǎn fā liàng hú dié yě luò zài shù yè shang shuì le
sentences.english: The stars outside the window shone, and the butterflies were asleep on the leaves.

sentences.simplified: 在这个美丽的春夜，他遇到了美丽的温姬。
sentences.traditional: 在這個美麗的春夜，他遇到了美麗的溫姬。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè ge měi lì de chūn yè tā yù dào le měi lì de wēn jī
sentences.english: On this beautiful spring night, he met the beautiful Wen Ji.

sentence_translations: Brave Woman
The rain had stopped. The rainwater quickly dried up in the sun.
When Zhou Ming returned home, he was still a little dazed, like he had been dreaming.
It was strange. When he thought of that beautiful woman, he couldn’t think of anything else.
In the evening, Zhou Ming asked the servants taking care of him to leave and stayed at home by himself.
He didn’t know how long had passed when the woman arrived.
Zhou Ming opened the door for her, and the woman smiled and said to him, ..
.. “My name is Wen Ji. I am so happy to meet you.”
Wen Ji tilted her head and looked at Zhou Ming: “I like you very much, sir.
You are such a handsome and enchanting man, so I sneaked out of there to look for you.
Although my status is not good, I hope you know my heart: I want to be with you always.”
How difficult it is for a woman to say she likes you!
Wen Ji’s bravery and directness surprised Zhou Ming.
It was really strange. The girls that Zhou Ming had met before were all shy and gentle.
Just like Zhou Ming’s sisters, they would just obediently sit at home and learn how to be good wives and good mothers.
If there was a girl who said that she liked a man, then others would definitely say that she was “shameless”.
Zhou Ming used to think that women like his mother and sisters were very good. But now, he suddenly changed his mind.
“Is it because Wen Ji doesn’t understand this? But who has stipulated that all girls must have the same temper?
Good girls are very good, but Wen Ji is also very cute like this, isn’t she?”
Zhou Ming thought to himself, staring at Wen Ji blankly, and found that her smile was shy and mischievous.
Zhou Ming knew that she was shy of her own initiative, and at the same time, she was also very confident in herself.
She knew that the person in front of her would not reject her or criticize her.
Zhou Ming couldn’t help but smile.
His eyes were curved as he looked at the beautiful Wen Ji, and he reached out and hugged her gently.
A night breeze gently blew in through the window, blowing on two fiery hearts.
The stars outside the window shone, and the butterflies were asleep on the leaves.
On this beautiful spring night, he met the beautiful Wen Ji.
